FIND YOUR FIT

A little clarity
before you join.

Where can I find current membership information?+

The Academy’s official Skool page has current program and membership information. Review the offer there before joining.

Do I need to join a program to contact Greg?+

No. You can use the contact page to ask a question about his community work and where to start.

Is community coaching a clinical service?+

The community content presented here concerns personal development and shared learning. It is not a substitute for individualized medical or mental-health care.
